standard_prerequisites.name: Exactness of the Cech complex
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Sheaves on Stacks, Proposition stacks-sheaves-proposition-exactness-cech-complex with Lemma stacks-sheaves-lemma-surjective-flat-locally-finite-presentation

standard_prerequisites.name: Surjective flat lfp families
standard_prerequisites.use: Provides the covering factoring through the f_j.

core_obligations: Single-cover case: the Cech exact sequence for a surjective flat lfp qcqs a (cited exactness-cech-complex proposition), b^*F lqc by pullback (cited pullback-lqc), a_*a^*F and b_*b^*F lqc by the pushforward-lqc lemma, hence F lqc by the lqc-colimits lemma (proof lines 741-761).

Reduction: Zariski-locally U affine; the surjective-family lemma gives an fppf covering factoring through the f_j, so a_i^*F is lqc; refine to a standard fppf covering so the pullback by the disjoint union is lqc; conclude x^*F is lqc and F|_{U_etale} is quasi-coherent (proof lines 764-781).
proof_roadmap: Prove descent for a single surjective flat lfp qcqs cover via the Cech sequence.
Reduce the general covering to the single-cover case by standard-covering refinement.
difficulty_reason: Two-stage proof: first, for a single surjective flat lfp qcqs cover a, the Cech exact sequence 0 -> F -> a_*a^*F -> b_*b^*F is quoted, b^*F is lqc as a pullback of a^*F, the pushforwards are lqc by the pushforward-lqc lemma, and F is lqc by the lqc-colimits lemma closing the sequence; second, the general case is reduced by Zariski-localizing to affine U and refining the fppp covering to a standard one, i.e. pullback by a disjoint union of the covering pieces is lqc, and the first paragraph applies.
